method: Ohana, Zhang & Yu 2026 SIMPLIFIED joint likelihood (arXiv:2608.04362)
note: Simplified reproduction. Uses Yang+ 2024/2025 parametric SIDM halo model (Eq. 4-5 of Ohana+) with MCMC over (M_200, c_200, tau). Gas profile approximated as N_HI ~ rho_DM^2 * r (proxy for full hydrostatic + Benitez-Llambay+ 2017 T(rho) + Rahmati+ 2013 HI fraction, which is v19.2 work). Sigma/m is NOT independently inferred from tau via Balberg+ formula -- the unit conventions in Ohana+ Eq. 6 cannot be parsed from the paper text alone. Instead, we report sigma/m as the median of the parameter space weighted by posterior, and compare the c-M tension to published values. The (sigma/m, c_200) DEGENERACY is the key qualitative finding from Ohana+ Section 3.2, which this simplified reproduction captures.
limitations: Gas profile is a proxy (rho_DM^2 * r), not full hydrostatic equilibrium.
N_HI observation is synthetic (constructed from Ohana+ best-fit), not the actual Cloud-9 data (Benitez-Llambay+ 2024).
Sigma/m not inverted from tau via Balberg+ formula (unit convention issue in Ohana+ Eq. 6).
MCMC uses emcee (affine-invariant), not Ohana+'s Rust stretch-move.
Cannot reproduce GIZMO N-body for Silverman+ 2026 -- that requires FIRE-2 ICs + multi-day cluster runs.
